title: hieracium rigidum subsp. boreanum
intro: Hieracium rigidum subsp. boreanum, commonly known as the Boreal Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The Boreal Hawkweed has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. Therapeutically, this plant is known for its diuretic and expectorant actions, which can aid in the relief of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the Boreal Hawkweed include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
